title: Grade 7 Science — Mon, Jun 01
description: Nutrition in Animals — Day 1 of 5: Modes of feeding and steps of nutrition
subject: science

questions.question: Unlike plants, animals cannot make their own food, so their mode of nutrition is:
questions.explanation: Animals depend on other organisms for food, so their nutrition is heterotrophic.

questions.question: Which is the correct order of the steps of nutrition in animals?
questions.explanation: The steps are ingestion, digestion, absorption, assimilation and egestion, in that order.

questions.question: The taking in of food is called:
questions.explanation: Ingestion is the process of taking food into the body.

questions.question: Breaking down complex food into simpler substances is called:
questions.explanation: Digestion breaks down complex food into simple, absorbable substances.

questions.question: Removal of undigested food from the body is called:
questions.explanation: Egestion is the removal of undigested waste from the body.

questions.question: An amoeba takes in food using finger-like extensions called:
questions.explanation: Amoeba captures food using pseudopodia (false feet) that surround the food.

questions.question: The temporary cavity in amoeba where food is digested is the:
questions.explanation: Inside the amoeba, food is digested in a food vacuole.

questions.question: Absorbed food being used by body cells for energy and growth is called:
questions.explanation: Assimilation is when absorbed nutrients are used by cells for energy, growth and repair.

questions.question: A hydra catches its prey using:
questions.explanation: Hydra uses its tentacles to capture and pull prey towards its mouth.

questions.question: Why do animals need nutrition?
options: For energy, growth and repair of the body
questions.explanation: Food provides energy and materials needed for growth and repair of body cells.

questions.question: Which animal does NOT chew its food but swallows it whole?
questions.explanation: Snakes swallow their prey whole without chewing it.

questions.question: In which step does digested food pass into the blood?
questions.explanation: During absorption, the digested simple food passes into the blood.

questions.question: Different animals have different feeding methods mainly because of differences in their:
questions.explanation: Feeding methods depend on what animals eat and how their bodies are built.

questions.question: Which sequence shows what happens AFTER digestion?
questions.explanation: After digestion, food is absorbed, then assimilated, and the waste is egested.

questions.question: A butterfly feeds on nectar using its long tube-like mouthpart called a:
questions.explanation: A butterfly sucks nectar through its long coiled proboscis.
